fusions.name: Hoofbeat Pulse
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 7 damage. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Cavalry Charge
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 30 damage, ignoring armour, harder the further it travels, up to 2.5 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Breakaway
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward. Using it increases your movement speed by 30% for 4s.

fusions.name: Open Road
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 16%.
